title: The Deepest Hall
journal: The third seal-stone lies in the vault of Vorannuhl's deep halls, behind a door of bronze that no pick will open. Sarpa raiders shelter in the outer yard, and one of them, Hesh-Var, carries the bronze key. I can lift it from him unseen, or kill him and take it; if the raiders catch me at his belt, they all attack.
objectives: Get the Bronze Key of Vorannuhl from Hesh-Var in the outer yard. (marker: Hesh-Var, Vorannuhl)

plan.going: The Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel, sits at the Root under Teku-Sul, where the roots of every Hist meet; used there it heals every sick tree. The Kings' Gate shuts it in and opens only with three seal-stones. I am hunting the third seal-stone, in Vorannuhl's deep vault, the hardest place of the hunt
plan.next: get the bronze key from Hesh-Var at the yard's fire
plan.ways: pickpocket it from him unseen (Sneak and Pickpocket), or fight the raiders and take it from his body (any fighting skill); the raiders shoot strangers

answers: I am hunting the seal-stones that lock away the Eye at the Root. I hold Blackrose and Gemin; the third is in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, behind a bronze door no pick opens. Rivals are the Unbound and the collector Ennodius Vanin.
Get the Bronze Key from Hesh-Var, a Sarpa raider in the outer yard of Vorannuhl, then open the vault door.
Pickpocket Hesh-Var (if caught, all raiders attack), or kill him and take the key.
I do not know why the Unbound drain trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or how Nesh-Deeka knows of the Unbound. I could ask people or read more.

title: The Deepest Hall
journal: I have the Bronze Key of Vorannuhl. The plague-dead of the old household walk the deep halls, and their lord, a wraith, guards the vault; they attack whoever they see. Down there the key opens the vault and the stone. I can fight, slip past or turn the dead with Restoration.
objectives: Open the Vault of the Household with the bronze key and take the seal-stone. (marker: Door to Vault of the Household, Household's Hoard)

plan.going: I hold the key; the stone is in the vault below
plan.next: go down, open the vault, take the stone
plan.ways: fight the plague-dead and the wraith-lord; sneak past them; turn them with Restoration

answers: I stole the Bronze Key unseen. The deep halls hold plague-dead and a wraith lord guarding the vault with the third seal-stone.
Go through the Door to Vault of the Household and open the vault with the key, take the stone.
Fight the dead, slip past them, or turn them with Restoration (I am not sure I have that skill).
I do not know the wraith lord by name or how strong he is; I would find out by exploring.

title: The Deepest Hall
journal: I took the third seal-stone from the vault of Vorannuhl. I now carry all three seal-stones. Never-Writes-Twice ordered all three brought to her before anyone goes near the gate, in Nesh-Deeka's House in Helstrom.

plan.going: I hold all three seal-stones of the Kings' Gate
plan.next: bring them to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House, Helstrom, as her orders said, before going to the gate
plan.ways: none; the report is the step

answers: I now hold all three seal-stones. The wraith lord did not stop me. Never-Writes-Twice wants all three brought to her before anyone goes near the Kings Gate.
Take them to Nesh-Deeka House in Helstrom, to Never-Writes-Twice.
Obey and deliver them, or go straight to the Kings Gate under Teku-Sul Spire. I must not lift the Eye.
I still do not know why the Unbound drain trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or how Nesh-Deeka knows of the Unbound.
